name: Jack Powell
original_name: ジャック パウウェル
source:
He is one of the team’s strategists. He is an exceptionally intelligent and able man, who can come up with ideas to break out of any situation. The pendant that hangs from his neck may be the key to unlocking the secrets of his birth.
Like Tsubasa, he also has the zombie virus antibodies within him, which leads him to head for the Clock Tower in order to save humanity.

[Source: [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.zombiekaigai&hl=en]Google Play[/url]]
